load_manifest_from_csv_dir: load an Ego4D manifest from a directory of CSV files into a Manifest dataclass with videos, components, and annotations
load_egoexo_manifest_from_csv_dir: load an EgoExo manifest from a directory of CSV files into a ManifestEgoExo dataclass with captures, takes, and videos
load_dataclass_dict_from_csv: create a function that reads a CSV file and returns a dictionary of dataclass objects keyed by a specified field
load_standard_metadata_files: load standard metadata CSV files for devices, component types, and scenarios from a folder into a StandardMetadata dataclass
load_released_video_files: load a CSV of released video files and return a dictionary mapping video IDs to their file paths
